properties.title: HydroLAKES
properties.description: Shoreline polygons of all global lakes with a surface area of at least 10 ha.

table:columns.name: Hylak_id
table:columns.description: Unique lake identifier (shared with HydroRIVERS / HydroBASINS)

table:columns.name: Lake_name
table:columns.description: Lake or reservoir name

table:columns.name: Country
table:columns.description: Country in which the lake is located

table:columns.name: Continent
table:columns.description: Continent in which the lake is located

table:columns.name: Poly_src
table:columns.description: Source of the lake polygon (e.g. SWBD, CanVec, CLAKES)

table:columns.name: Lake_type
table:columns.description: Lake type: 1 = lake, 2 = reservoir, 3 = lake control structure

table:columns.name: Grand_id
table:columns.description: ID of the reservoir in the GRanD database (0 if not a GRanD reservoir)

table:columns.name: Lake_area
table:columns.description: Lake surface area (km2)

table:columns.name: Shore_len
table:columns.description: Shoreline length (km)

table:columns.name: Shore_dev
table:columns.description: Shoreline development: shoreline length / circumference of a circle with the same area (-)

table:columns.name: Vol_total
table:columns.description: Total lake or reservoir volume (million m3)

table:columns.name: Vol_res
table:columns.description: Reported reservoir volume (million m3)

table:columns.name: Vol_src
table:columns.description: Source of the volume: 1 = reported total volume, 2 = reported reservoir volume, 3 = estimated

table:columns.name: Depth_avg
table:columns.description: Average lake depth (m)

table:columns.name: Dis_avg
table:columns.description: Average long-term discharge through the lake (m3/s)

table:columns.name: Res_time
table:columns.description: Average residence time (days)

table:columns.name: Elevation
table:columns.description: Elevation of the lake surface (m above sea level)

table:columns.name: Slope_100
table:columns.description: Average slope within a 100 m buffer around the lake (degrees ?)

table:columns.name: Wshd_area
table:columns.description: Area of the upstream watershed (km2)

table:columns.name: Pour_long
table:columns.description: Longitude of the lake pour point (degrees)

table:columns.name: Pour_lat
table:columns.description: Latitude of the lake pour point (degrees)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Lake / reservoir shoreline polygon (EPSG:4326)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>

data.title: HydroLAKES
data.description: Shoreline polygons of all global lakes with a surface area of at least 10 ha.
